notes: Ruling needed: «قال قرئ على أيوب من كتب أبي قلابة» cites a book by Abu Qilaba; the author of a cited book is not added, and أيوب is in the scene of the reading.
The step from حماد to أنس runs through the book («وكان هذا في الكتاب عن أنس»), not through a named transmitter; no link is filled in.
